Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and glad you’re moving forward. Below is a concise checklist and our PO expectations so your finance team can prepare files for faster turnaround. If any item is a blocker we can schedule a 20-min call.

Required vendor docs to start (please send as PDFs where possible):
- Completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) — filename: Helios_W9.pdf
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account, routing) — CSV or PDF ok
- Signed Master Services Agreement (if already agreed) or redlines
- Vendor contact POC + billing email for invoice submission
- (Optional) Certificate of Insurance if you expect to bill for services tied to on-site work

PO issuance & timeline: 
- Typical internal turnaround after we receive all docs is 3 business days (standard)
- If legal review of your MSA/redlines is required, add 5–7 business days
- Initial PO will usually be a blanket PO for the contracted spend; subsequent POs are issued per-billing event depending on account setup

Line-item guidance for invoices (to ensure automated PO matching):
- One invoice per PO number (preferred). If you must send a combined invoice, list PO numbers on each line.
- Line fields we match on: PO number, line description (max 160 chars), quantity, unit price, line total, tax if applicable
- Use numeric SKU where available (SKU: 12-digit or vendor-assigned), otherwise a short descriptive phrase (e.g., “Redwood inference - Hosted API - May 2026 consumption”)
- For recurring credits, include a single line per billing period with the period dates in the description

Attachments: I’m attaching our vendor onboarding checklist and a sample invoice mapping (vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf).

Next steps: please reply with W-9 + bank info and confirm billing email. I’ll loop Laura (Finance Ops) to provision the vendor record and create the initial PO.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Business Development | Redwood Inference
